topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: You wouldn't think a little piece of writing could cause this much fuss, but here I am, sifting through the rain-soaked streets of this city, chasing shadows. Kid comes to me, all worked up, says his college essay's been plastered all over some website as an "example." Clean, well-written, but now it's out there. Says he's worried about what it might mean, who might be watching. I get it, the stakes are high. College, the future—ain't no room for slip-ups. Got a lead on who might be behind it, though. Gotta tread carefully, don't want to spook whoever's pulling the strings. Stranger things in this town, but this one's got me watching my back.
